To address this, Nvidia is focusing on building a vast network of nimble regional cloud providers, which can react faster to local demand and infrastructure needs. This strategy helps Nvidia ensure its hardware is widely consumed and reinforces a shift in AI infrastructure where electricity, land, and data center capacity are as crucial as the chips themselves.

He highlighted the negative impacts of social media on children and countries, asserting that AI leaders must learn from past failures to build a foundation of responsibility. Benioff also pointed out that Salesforce is playing a key role in AI development, as evidenced by product announcements and collaborations with companies like Nvidia.

Summary: ExxonMobil plans to invest $20 billion in lower-emission projects between 2025 and 2030, with these ventures, including carbon capture and storage (CCS), lithium, and carbon materials, projected to generate over $1 billion in annual earnings by 2030. Summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is collaborating with SiFive to adapt its open-source ROCm AI software for RISC-V datacenter servers, signaling a move towards more open compute architectures. The effort is critical for AMD's broader investment case, testing its ability to build a comprehensive AI data center stack and compete effectively against rivals like Nvidia, while also managing the operational risks associated with a multi-alliance strategy.

The solution combines P&G's deep learning models with Siemens' Industrial Edge computing platform, leveraging Industrial AI to adapt to variations in production and improve product quality.

Title: Nvidia Is an ‘Awesome Company,’ but Its Stock Is Priced as ‘Greatest Company Ever,’ Damodaran Says
Summary: NYU Stern finance professor Aswath Damodaran views Nvidia as an "awesome company" but believes its stock valuation, exceeding $5 trillion, is priced as the "greatest company ever." He suggests that the current AI sector revenue and investment would require annual revenues of $8 trillion to $10 trillion to justify the infrastructure buildout, far beyond today's $250 billion. Damodaran posits that such growth is only achievable if AI replaces workers rather than merely augmenting productivity, which would then pose new economic challenges regarding consumer spending.

Summary: Joby Aviation (JOBY) has completed the first fully autonomous cross-country flight in the U.S., with its electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft flying without a pilot, monitored remotely. This milestone supports Joby's strategy for autonomous logistics, focusing on commercial cargo, medical supply, disaster relief, and defense logistics. The company aims to monetize its technology stack beyond passenger air taxis, but faces challenges in managing a broad business model compared to more focused rivals.

Title: NVIDIA Corporation $NVDA Holdings Decreased by a16z Perennial Management L.P.
Summary: a16z Perennial Management L.P. significantly reduced its holdings in NVIDIA Corporation by 91.4% in the second quarter, selling 34,015 shares and retaining 3,200 shares. Despite this, institutional investors still own a majority of NVIDIA stock, and the company reported strong financial results with revenue up 105.9% year-over-year and analysts maintaining a "Buy" rating. However, insider sales and potential risks like competition and rising memory costs are noted as areas of investor focus.

Title: HCI Group (HCI) Sustains Earnings Momentum, Is The Stock Still 23% Undervalued?
Summary: HCI Group (HCI) has shown strong earnings momentum with 15.5% annual growth in net premiums and 36.3% annual EPS expansion over two years. Despite recent stock stability, its current price of US$187.67 is considered 23% undervalued by analysts, with a fair value estimated at $245 per share, driven by its proprietary technology and efficient policy selection. However, risks such as Florida exposure, Citizens depopulation, and rising reinsurance costs could impact profitability.

Title: Should You Bet on the Businesses of Billionaires?
Summary: Bancreek Capital Advisors suggests investing in companies built by billionaires, even after their initial rapid growth, due to the unique advantages they possess. This strategy is embodied in their new Billionaires Club ETF (CLUB), which focuses on businesses with strong pricing power, scale, and durable moats, identified through a blend of fundamental value investing and data science. The ETF seeks steady, predictable compounding with low volatility, holding 30 equal-weighted names with global exposure.

Title: Equinix Plans $5B-$7B Annual Data Center Buildout as AI Demand Accelerates
Summary: Equinix plans to invest $5 billion to $7 billion annually in data center development, primarily in existing markets, driven by accelerating AI adoption among enterprise customers. The company aims for cash-on-cash returns in the low 20% range and expects to significantly increase its power capacity under development. Executives emphasized a customer-centric approach, building infrastructure where demand is visible and preparing facilities for higher-density AI workloads.

Title: Intel, Apple, Nvidia and More: 5 Stocks Investors Couldn't Stop Buzzing About This Week
Summary: This article highlights the five stocks that retail investors were most interested in this week: Intel, Apple, Nvidia, Nebius Group, and Oracle. These companies, spanning various tech sectors, saw significant discussion on social media platforms like X and Reddit, driven by factors such as AI infrastructure developments, earnings, and corporate news. The report provides a brief overview of the key events and stock performance for each company during the week.

Title: Keysight Technologies Sees AI Data-Center Boom, Targets 6G and Defense Growth
Summary: Keysight Technologies is experiencing strong demand from AI data-center buildouts, particularly in high-speed networking and silicon photonics, and is targeting future growth in 6G wireless, aerospace and defense, and software-defined vehicles. Despite supply constraints, the company is expanding capacity and expects to maintain high incremental margins while investing in R&D to capture these emerging opportunities.

Title: How Investors Are Reacting To Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical (RARE) First-In-Disease Gene Therapy Approval For FAYUVI
Summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical received full FDA approval for FAYUVI (UX111), a first-in-disease gene therapy for pediatric Sanfilippo syndrome Type A, alongside a Priority Review Voucher. This approval, coupled with another recent gene therapy approval for GENGLYCOS, expands Ultragenyx's commercial gene therapy portfolio. While these approvals improve the near-term outlook, investors should consider the company's high cash burn and potential for dilution, as the speed of adoption and reimbursement will be crucial for reaching profitability goals.

Title: Reverse split and new share issuance up for a vote at Azio AI (NASDAQ: AZIO)
Summary: Azio AI Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: AZIO) is seeking stockholder approval for a reverse stock split at a ratio between 1-for-15 and 1-for-30, and the issuance of up to 97.3 million new common shares through the conversion of Series A Preferred Stock. These measures are critical for the company to maintain its Nasdaq listing, which is at risk due to a stockholders’ equity deficiency and a current share price below the minimum requirement. The proposals also include the adoption of a new Equity Incentive Plan and are being presented during a virtual annual meeting where stockholders will also elect a director and ratify an auditor.

Title: Vistra Corp (VST) — Power Infrastructure Play for Data Centers Beyond Nuclear
Summary: Vistra Corp (VST) reported strong Q2 2026 results with over 30% year-over-year growth in Adjusted EBITDA, driven by increasing demand for reliable power from data centers. The company has secured long-term power purchase agreements with major tech companies like Amazon Web Services and Meta, providing significant revenue visibility. Vistra is strategically expanding its capacity through acquisitions and partnerships, positioning itself as a key player in the data center infrastructure ecosystem.

Title: Is Fidelity High Dividend ETF (FDVV) a Strong ETF Right Now?
Summary: The article analyzes the Fidelity High Dividend ETF (FDVV), a smart beta ETF launched in 2016, noting its significant asset base of over $9.66 billion. It details the fund's objective to track the Fidelity Core Dividend Index, focusing on high-dividend-paying companies, and highlights its low expense ratio of 0.15% and a 12-month trailing dividend yield of 3.59%. The ETF's sector exposure, top holdings, and performance are also discussed, along with potential alternatives for investors.

Title: Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: Aehr Test Systems vs. Super Micro Computer
Summary: This article compares Aehr Test Systems and Super Micro Computer as artificial intelligence stocks, highlighting their roles in the AI ecosystem, financial health, and risk profiles. While Aehr focuses on semiconductor testing, Super Micro provides high-performance server racks, with the author ultimately recommending Super Micro due to its strong sales growth and lower valuation despite recent controversies.

Title: KeyCorp Reaffirms 2026 Outlook as Loan Growth, Margins and Fees Gain Momentum
Summary: KeyCorp has reaffirmed its 2026 outlook, citing strong client activity, anticipated commercial loan growth at the higher end of its 4-5% target, improved credit quality, and deposit growth exceeding 2% in the latter half of the year. The bank raised its fee-income growth outlook to 4-5% following the Clearwater acquisition and is increasingly confident in achieving a core return on tangible common equity of over 15% by 2027. Despite a changing economic backdrop with expected rate increases, KeyCorp sees continued healthy activity in both lending and fee-based businesses.

Title: Equinix Sees AI Driving Data Center Demand, Interconnection Growth
Summary: Equinix executives indicate that artificial intelligence is significantly accelerating demand for high-density data center capacity and interconnection services, requiring more complex, low-latency infrastructure. The company's interconnection business grew 9% this year, supported by new offerings like Fabric One and Inference Exchange, which address the complex networking needs of AI workloads. Equinix anticipates 9%-12% annual adjusted funds from operations per-share growth through 2029, driven by robust demand and development projects generating mid-20% cash yields.

Title: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby Has a Simple PowerPoint Rule — And This Strict Limit Shows How Seriously He Takes It
Summary: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby enforces a strict "no reading slides" rule for meetings, requiring PowerPoint decks to be sent in advance to encourage conversation. He believes his job as CEO is to "think hard," not "work hard," dedicating significant time to reading and focusing on future strategy. This approach is similar to other prominent CEOs like Jeff Bezos and Jensen Huang, who have also redefined traditional meeting norms to foster more substantive discussions.

Title: Eight NVIDIA GPUs are set for U.S. missile defense modeling
Summary: One Stop Systems (OSS) secured a roughly $400,000 award from a leading U.S. defense prime contractor to provide advanced computing for missile defense system modeling and simulation. The award involves OSS's 4UP Max PCIe expansion platform, configured with eight NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, marking a significant upgrade for complex simulation workloads. This deployment highlights OSS's role in supporting critical national defense applications with high-performance computing.

Title: Have Insiders Sold Rocket Pharmaceuticals Shares Recently?
Summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: RCKT) recently saw its General Counsel, Martin Wilson, sell US$256k worth of shares, representing an 11% reduction in his holding. While this was the largest insider sale in the past year, insiders have sold more shares than they have bought overall. Despite insiders owning about 4.0% of the company, Simply Wall St suggests caution due to the selling activity and advises investors to consider potential risks.
